# Test Rulebook

Written for the test suite in its own words. It is shaped like the SRD - nested
headings, terms that recur across sections - but it is not SRD text.

## Conditions

### Grappled

A grappled creature cannot move: its speed becomes 0. The condition ends if whoever holds
it is incapacitated, or if an effect carries the creature out of their reach.

### Prone

A prone creature can only crawl, unless it stands up, which costs half its movement.
Attacks against it from close by have advantage; from far away, disadvantage.

### Exhaustion

Exhaustion comes in levels, and each level adds to the last. At the sixth level the
creature dies. A long rest with food and water removes one level.

## Combat

### Grappling

To grab a creature, make a Strength (Athletics) check against its Strength (Athletics) or
Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If you win, it is grappled. Escaping a grapple uses the same
contest, on the grappled creature's turn.

### Cover

Half cover gives a bonus of 2 to armor class. Three-quarters cover gives a bonus of 5.
Total cover means the creature cannot be targeted directly at all.

### Falling

A fall deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet fallen, to a maximum of 20d6. The
creature lands prone unless it avoids the damage.
